name: Metalworks of Montana Inc.
old_description: Since 1985, Metalworks of Montana has been providing sheet metal fabrication, welding, and commercial low-slope roof contracting services throughout Montana, Idaho, and Washington.
about:
Metalworks of Montana, operating as Missoula Sheet Metal, has been based in Missoula, Montana since its founding in 1985. The company is locally owned and operated; its leadership includes President/Owner Jeff Gordon and Vice President Aiden Curran, with a team that collectively holds over 100 years of metalworking experience.

The shop provides sheet metal fabrication, welding (both in-house and on-site), and commercial low-slope roof contracting across Montana, Idaho, and Washington. It manufactures HVAC components, structural steel, architectural sheet metal, custom stainless steel products, ductwork, venting systems (including chimney caps, oven range hoods, and industrial kitchen venting), as well as custom kitchen décor, automotive accessories, signage, stairways, platforms, and mezzanines. Roofing services cover single-ply membrane, modified bitumen, and built-up systems.

Customers span commercial construction, HVAC, industrial kitchen, automotive, marine (boats, RVs, trucks, trailers), and architectural metalwork. The company holds contractor licenses in Montana (#8192), Idaho (#15815-AA-4), and Washington (#MISSOSM962MG), allowing it to serve projects throughout the Northwest.

Metalworks emphasizes customer service, listening to client needs to deliver projects exactly as specified, and draws on more than three decades of experience to offer precision fabrication and roofing solutions. It is licensed and bonded in all three states.
